about: Every radius-2 rooted code of a pinwheel tiling's planar map, with the oriented label of its dart: (left tile's side, interval start, interval end), (right tile's side, start, end), whether the two sides run the same way. Codes as in PINWHEEL-NATIVE-20261107-001B: per discovered vertex, its degree and its neighbours' discovery numbers in counterclockwise order from the vertex it was entered from (-1: beyond radius 2).
